description: Teacher: review a lesson draft before approving it. Returns the scene plan, who holds each answer key (author_keyed / production / externally_grounded), the linter's verdict, remaining TODO placeholders, and whether an approval record exists for this exact lesson.json. Also returns a review inbox: one item per scene, sorted by consequence (blocks, grading, wording, media) and marked new / changed / unchanged since the last review receipt; a scene that holds an answer key gets no fingerprint, because a hash of its keys would let anyone test guesses against it. Each inbox item carries a preview of what learners see: the scene's title, type and first 280 characters of its learner-facing text (a quiz's choices are left out). Never returns answer keys, hints or reveals. Read-only.
name: review_lesson
